### ST-056

**Direct test selection**

*As a **developer**, I want **tests that directly target changed symbols selected**, so that **the most relevant tests always run**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S5 | G01, §11.2 | [ST-041](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-041), [ST-046](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-046), [ST-052](EXE-test-execution.md#st-052) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Changed test files are always selected
- [x] Tests with a TESTS edge to a changed symbol are selected with reason `direct-dependency`
- [x] Output conforms to `ImpactDecision`

---

### ST-057

**Transitive test selection**

*As a **developer**, I want **tests reachable through dependents selected**, so that **regressions in callers are caught**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S5 | G02 | [ST-056](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-056) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Selection includes tests reachable via reverse IMPORTS/CALLS/EXTENDS/INSTANTIATES edges
- [x] Each selected test carries the graph path as evidence
- [x] Depth limits are mode-dependent and reported

---

### ST-058

**Mandatory selection triggers**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **broad verification forced for global-impact changes**, so that **config and dependency changes can't slip through**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S6 | G05, §11.4 | [ST-056](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-056), [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Changes to tsconfig, runner config, package manifests/lockfiles, env config and global setup files trigger the full suite (or configured scope)
- [x] Each trigger is reported with reason `mandatory-trigger`
- [x] Rules can add triggers but cannot remove built-in ones

---

### ST-059

**Safe fallback on partial analysis**

*As a **developer**, I want **SmartTest to widen or run everything when it isn't sure**, so that **uncertainty never silently drops tests**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S5 | G09, §1.5, §32.2 | [ST-056](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-056) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Unresolved imports/dynamic patterns touching the change trigger fallback per mode
- [x] `analysisStatus` = partial/fallback and `fallbackApplied` = true are reported
- [x] Fallback reason is printed in the summary

---

### ST-060

**FAST, BALANCED and SAFE modes**

*As a **developer**, I want **to choose a safety mode per run, rule or CI context**, so that **local feedback is fast and releases are strict**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S6 | G06, G07, G08, §11.3 | [ST-057](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-057), [ST-058](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-058), [ST-059](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-059) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `--mode fast|balanced|safe`; default balanced
- [x] SAFE widens selection, ignores comment-only optimisations and forces full suite on any uncertainty
- [x] Mode used is shown in output and reports

### ST-061

**Risk classification**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **changes classified by risk using rules and change kind**, so that **critical code is treated more conservatively**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟧 Should | 3 | S6 | G04 | [ST-041](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-041), [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Risk = max(rule risk, change-kind risk)
- [x] Critical risk upgrades the effective mode to SAFE for affected areas
- [x] Risk appears in explain output

### ST-063

**`smarttest run --affected` and `smarttest impact`**

*As a **developer**, I want **one command to analyse changes and run only affected tests**, so that **I get the core value of SmartTest**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S6 | §11, §26.2, §40 | [ST-057](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-057), [ST-059](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-059), [ST-053](EXE-test-execution.md#st-053), [ST-014](CLI-cli-developer-experience.md#st-014) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `run --affected` = change detection → impact → execution → summary
- [x] `impact` prints the decision without running tests
- [x] `run --all` runs the full suite through the same pipeline
- [x] Summary shows selected, executed, skipped (not run), passed, failed and duration

### ST-064

**`smarttest validate-selection`**

*As a **team lead evaluating SmartTest**, I want **to compare a selective run against a full reference run**, so that **I have evidence before trusting selection in CI**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S9 | G12, §11.7, §32.4 | [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063), [ST-095](QLT-reliability-and-performance.md#st-095) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Runs selection and full suite on the same change and compares outcomes
- [x] Reports selected, skipped, failures found, failures missed, time saved, analysis overhead, flaky interference
- [x] Any missed failure exits 5 and prints the dependency gap
